allowed_uses: Historical-vintage literature priors with explicit price basis and sample/model mapping
Published China sample range comparison and internal source discrepancy diagnostics
Generic life/construction reference where national specification is missing, labeled assumption
prohibited_uses: Historical or future national parameter admission without model-specific review
Mixing 2008 costs with nominal2014 finance without explicit price conversion
Treating aggregate levelized O&M as identified variable dispatch cost
Using sample load factors as measured national hourly availability
Inventing plant permits, retirement events or queues from expected study life
Silently reconciling main/annex conflicting fuel data
Turning report zero-carbon-price convention into a verified Chinese policy
